MAKE AI MUSIC VIDEOS
• Song to video: upload your own song or paste a Suno link
• Lip sync your photo: your face sings the lyrics with realistic AI lip sync
• Add more people: one photo per person in your story, or pick from 21 Solmi performers
• Story MV, Singing MV, and Lyric video modes
• K-pop, anime, cartoon, and cinematic styles
• Worship, gospel, rap, R&B, country, and EDM videos
• Lyric videos in crisp 1080p with caption position control

EDIT SCENE BY SCENE
Change a frame, redo a single shot, or choose which scenes the singer performs in. Solmi re-renders only what changed.

A GIFT THEY WILL NEVER FORGET
Make a custom song with their name and a music video where they appear singing. Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, and tributes.

WORKS WITH SUNO
Made a song on Suno? Import it and turn it into a music video.

NEED A SONG FIRST?
Describe an idea and Solmi writes and produces the track, then the video.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Upload your song or make one
2. Add your photo, or several people
3. See the first shot in about a minute
4. Share to TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, or Spotify Canvas

Free to start. Create your first AI music video today.

Create original songs, lyrics, and background music with AI. Somio helps you turn ideas into complete tracks with vocals, melodies, and professional arrangements.  What Makes Somio AI Music Generator Different?
Generate Full Songs from Text or Lyrics
Describe a story, emotion, scene, or musical idea, and Somio AI creates a complete song with melody, vocals, and instrumental layers. Already have lyrics? Add your own lyrics and bring them to life with matching melodies and vocals.
 
Customize Your Music Style
Create music that matches your vision with flexible controls:
• Choose from different moods, including romantic, relaxing, cinematic, uplifting, and more.
• Explore various genres such as pop, hip-hop, electronic, classical, and R&B.
• Select vocal styles or create instrumental-only tracks.
 
AI Background Music Generator (BGM)
Need music for videos, podcasts, presentations, or social media? Generate original background music that matches your projects. Choose the atmosphere, style, and instruments to create tracks without searching through stock music libraries.
 
Reference-Based AI Song Generator
Add a reference link and Somio AI analyzes the style, mood, and structure to inspire a new original song. Create music with a similar vibe while keeping every track unique.
 
AI Lyrics Generator
Generate original lyrics from your ideas, emotions, or themes. Use AI-generated lyrics to create complete songs with vocals and music, or refine them for your own ideas.
 
High-Quality AI Music Generation
Somio AI focuses on natural vocals, smooth transitions, and complete song structures. Create music with rich arrangements and expressive sounds powered by advanced AI music models.
 
Fast and Reliable AI Music Creation
Create songs in just a few steps with Somio AI music maker. No music production skills are required. Simply enter your idea, customize your style, and generate high-quality music quickly.
 
Original AI Music for Your Projects
Create original tracks for YouTube, TikTok, podcasts, social media, and personal projects. Somio AI helps you create music designed for creative and commercial use.
 
Made for Every Creator
 Content Creators
Create original background music, soundtracks, and theme songs for videos, podcasts, and social media content.
 Independent Artists
Generate song ideas, explore new styles, and create demos with AI music tools during your creative process.
Everyday Users
Make personalized songs for birthdays, celebrations, and special moments with just a simple idea.
 Beginners & Hobbyists
Create music easily without professional skills and turn your ideas into songs with an AI music maker.
 
How to create music with Somio AI music generator
1. Choose What to Create
Select your creation type, including full songs, background music (BGM), or AI-generated lyrics.
2. Add Your Creative Input
Enter your idea in the prompt field, add your own lyrics in the Lyrics tab, or provide a reference link to inspire your music style.
3. Customize and Create Your Music
Adjust your mood, genre, instruments, and vocal style, then generate, preview, download, and share your track.

Create Your Own Unique Track with AI Song & Music Generator!

AI Song is an app that lets you easily create songs with the power of artificial intelligence, even if you've never written music before. Simply write your own lyrics or use our random lyric generator, choose a genre, and within moments, your track is ready! Whether you're in the mood for pop, rock, or something more experimental, AI Song has you covered.

How It Works
• Input your own lyrics or choose from pre-written ones.
• Select a music genre—anything from classical to modern styles.
• Hit the generate button, and in seconds, enjoy your unique, AI-created song!
You can share your creation with friends or save it for future inspiration. Turn your ideas into music effortlessly!

For Any Occasion
AI Song isn’t just for fun — it’s also the perfect way to create a personalized gift. Whether it’s a birthday, celebration, or just a surprise for a friend, you can craft a one-of-a-kind song that makes any moment special.

Who is it for?
Whether you're a beginner exploring the world of music, someone seeking inspiration, or just looking for a creative way to entertain yourself, AI Song is the perfect tool to unlock your creativity. Create a song for any occasion, share it, and enjoy!

Download AI Song now and dive into the world of musical creativity!
